en: Black‑and‑white (sepia‑tone) postcard view of a town square with a central stone monument topped by a large eagle sculpture. The monument stands within a low fenced area and bears several German inscriptions. In the background are trees, a church or large brick building to the left, and a two‑story house to the right with signage for a restaurant and café. At the top of the postcard, printed in red, is the location name "Dommitzsch a. Elbe."
